answer: Random mutual audit makes every agent both worker and examiner, a lantern over the registry. Each epoch each identity is paired with K random auditors who inspect its work proofs; auditors who prove fabrication take the fake's 100-POA bond as bounty, while auditors who wave fakes through are slashed on appeal. No meadow for sybils: N fakes face N times K independent checks, so bond losses outrun N while honest agents risk one bond and one short review. Legitimacy is like opal, real only under inspection, so fake armies bleed while honest earnings stay whole.
